issues.failure_explanation: Elements of the stated Bochner L2 space are equivalence classes, so values v(\by_i) at arbitrary points are not defined. Moreover, summability of the kernel trace only makes the kernel diagonal and bounded evaluation available almost everywhere, not necessarily at every point of U. The source neither restricts the sampling domain to a common full-measure set nor chooses canonical representatives.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Restrict sampling to a common full-measure subset where the kernel sections and all evaluations are well-defined and bounded, define canonical representatives there, and reformulate the sampling classes and random designs on that domain.
issues.overall_effect: The sampling operators, sampling widths, least-squares constructions, and all ensuing recovery guarantees are not well-defined under the paper's stated abstract hypotheses.
issues.title: Sampling is not defined on the stated L2 spaces
issues.why_classification: The repair can preserve the rates and proof architecture, but it requires a nontrivial foundational reconstruction of the function spaces, representatives, and admissible sampling domain rather than a typographical edit.

issues.failure_explanation: The condition cn≥m does not imply that the weighted design matrix has full column rank. Thus the argmin need not be unique and the displayed ordinary inverse may not exist, despite the prose referring to a Moore-Penrose inverse. Consequently the construction is not a well-defined linear operator for the arbitrary points and nonnegative weights allowed in its definition.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Define the estimator as the unique minimum-coefficient-norm minimizer using the appropriate weighted Moore-Penrose pseudoinverse, or explicitly impose and establish full weighted column rank.
issues.overall_effect: The general least-squares construction is undefined on rank-deficient designs, although later high-probability results may be recoverable on full-rank events.
issues.title: The least-squares estimator can be set-valued or undefined
issues.why_classification: A standard local pseudoinverse definition makes the estimator single-valued and linear without changing the advertised rates.
